Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: When instructed to open authoritative sources (e.g., Britannica) to verify regimental involvement, WebSurfer repeatedly reran the same DuckDuckGo query and surfaced Wikipedia/EV snippets without opening or extracting from the requested source. This repetitive, incomplete execution ignored the Planner’s directive, stalled progress, and risked basing the conclusion on uncorroborated snippets rather than credible verification.
